title: The 8 Best Robot Vacuums
subtitle: Robot vacuums and mops, from budget to self-emptying, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: We pulled the best-selling robot vacuums on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: self-emptying docks, mopping, and mapping. The table shows which ones work with Matter.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

awards.name: roborock Qrevo S Pro
awards.why: 18,500 Pa, an all-in-one dock with a sealed bag, and zero-tangle brushes for pet hair, with 4.0 stars from 1,994 reviews and 6K+ bought in the past month.

buyers_guide.q: Do I need a self-emptying dock?
buyers_guide.a: If you have pets or long hair in the house, yes. A dock that empties the bin means you deal with dirt every month or two instead of every run.

buyers_guide.q: Is a mopping robot worth it?
buyers_guide.a: For hard floors, a robot that mops and washes its own mop pads saves real work. Pick one that lifts the mop on carpet, or keep it off rugs.

buyers_guide.q: Does it work with my smart home?
buyers_guide.a: Most robot vacuums use their maker's Wi-Fi app with Alexa and Google voice commands. Newer models add Matter, which lets Apple Home, SmartThings, and Home Assistant start and stop cleaning.
